barbs.name: Plain Speaking
barbs.line: I'll say it plainly, since no one else will: your poem was long.

barbs.name: Hammered Smile
barbs.line: What a brave choice of colours. Truly. Brave.

barbs.name: Cold Quench
barbs.line: You've cooled since winter court, I hear. So has every room you walk into.

barbs.name: Anvil Silence
barbs.line: (a long, ringing silence, exactly where the compliment should be)

barbs.name: Kaiu Fire
barbs.line: The Kaiu test a blade by striking it. Yours bent on the first word.

barbs.name: Polished Remark
barbs.line: Your fan is lovely. It must be the one your mother carried.

barbs.name: Green with Age
barbs.line: Is that the new style? It was new when my grandfather wore it.

barbs.name: Bell Tone
barbs.line: Everyone heard what you said to the Crane. Everyone. Even the Crane.

barbs.name: Tarnish
barbs.line: I polished my opinion of you for an hour. It still came out dull.

barbs.name: Temple Bell at Dawn
barbs.line: Like the temple bell, you are loud, early, and nobody asked.

barbs.name: Horned Grin
barbs.line: Smile wider. It helps hide the rest of your face.

barbs.name: Iron Club
barbs.line: (the mask laughs, once, like a club on a drum)

barbs.name: Demon's Courtesy
barbs.line: Even an oni says please before it eats. You didn't, at dinner.

barbs.name: Torn Gate
barbs.line: I came through your defences like rice paper. Because they were.

barbs.name: Ogre's Table Manners
barbs.line: My lord the oni sends his regards. He says your manners remind him of home.

barbs.name: Sap and Splinter
barbs.line: Your verse had such a strong root. Pity about everything that grew from it.

barbs.name: Fragrant Pause
barbs.line: (she breathes in the cedar and lets the insult pass through her)

barbs.name: Deep Roots
barbs.line: My family has sat in these halls for six hundred years. Remind me how long yours has?

barbs.name: Knot in the Grain
barbs.line: Something's caught in your story. Just there. A knot. Shall I pull it?

barbs.name: Felled Cedar
barbs.line: The tallest cedar falls loudest. Do keep standing. We're all listening.

barbs.name: Bending Agreement
barbs.line: Oh, you're quite right. Quite right. Everyone says so, behind you.

barbs.name: Weeping Branch
barbs.line: (she sighs, very gently, at nothing in particular)

barbs.name: River-Bank Gossip
barbs.line: The ferrymen talk about you. They say you tip like a Crab.

barbs.name: Supple Retort
barbs.line: I bend. You break. That is the whole difference between us.

barbs.name: Willow in the Storm
barbs.line: I've weathered worse winds than you. Hotter ones, too.

barbs.name: Long Nose
barbs.line: I'd look down on you, but first I'd have to find you.

barbs.name: Feather Flick
barbs.line: (she flicks an imaginary feather from her sleeve, unhurried)

barbs.name: Mountain Lesson
barbs.line: The tengu taught the first swordsmen. Someone should teach you to sit.

barbs.name: Crow's Cackle
barbs.line: Ha! You thought that was clever. How sweet. How mortal.

barbs.name: Sermon from the Peak
barbs.line: From up here your ambitions look like ants. Very busy ants.

barbs.name: Empty Bowl
barbs.line: You've filled your speech with so much. Was any of it yours?

barbs.name: Still Breath
barbs.line: (the plain mask says nothing, and the nothing steadies her)

barbs.name: Whose Face?
barbs.line: Forgive me. Which of your faces am I speaking to today?

barbs.name: Unchosen
barbs.line: You don't have to choose, you know. You can simply stop pretending.

barbs.name: Silent Self
barbs.line: (the plain wooden face regards them, and they hear every unkind thing they ever thought of themselves)

barbs.name: Hot Lacquer
barbs.line: Red suits you. It hides the blushing.

barbs.name: Gloss
barbs.line: (her laugh is bright and sticky as fresh lacquer)

barbs.name: Burnt Offering
barbs.line: A gift for the Champion? How thoughtful. He'll give it to his servants.

barbs.name: Seven Coats
barbs.line: Seven coats of lacquer, and I can still see straight through you.

barbs.name: Crack in the Kiln
barbs.line: Some pots crack in the kiln. It isn't shameful. It's only what they were.

barbs.name: Jealous Glance
barbs.line: What a handsome escort. Does he know he's yours yet?

barbs.name: Smouldering
barbs.line: (the painted eyes follow them, slow and patient)

barbs.name: Letters
barbs.line: Your husband writes beautiful letters. To several people.

barbs.name: Horns Behind the Smile
barbs.line: Smile, darling. The horns only come out when you frown.

barbs.name: The Bell at Dojo-ji
barbs.line: The bell at Dojo-ji is still warm, they say. Someone should have kept his promises.

barbs.name: Apologetic Truth
barbs.line: I'm so sorry. Someone should have told you, and it seems it has to be me.

barbs.name: Warm Like Skin
barbs.line: (Giseiki murmurs something kind inside the mask, and she steadies)

barbs.name: The Maker's Regret
barbs.line: I made a mask like your face once. I broke it. I hope you don't mind my saying.

barbs.name: Hungry
barbs.line: Some masks are fuller than others. Yours seems... hungry.

barbs.name: Red and Black
barbs.line: Three hundred years in a mask teaches patience. You, sama, have exhausted it.

barbs.name: Blotted Line
barbs.line: Lovely brushwork in your letter. Was the blot on purpose? It's the best part.

barbs.name: Washes Off
barbs.line: (the ink runs a little, then sets again)

barbs.name: Ink Stone
barbs.line: Your name will be in the histories. In a footnote. In a small brush.

barbs.name: Tattooed Wall
barbs.line: A Togashi drew a wall on his face. You would need a castle.

barbs.name: Last Stroke
barbs.line: Every scroll ends somewhere. I think we've reached yours.

barbs.name: Drizzle
barbs.line: Ah. You've arrived. Like the rainy season: expected, endured.

barbs.name: Grey Sky
barbs.line: (she says nothing at all, and the conversation clouds over)

barbs.name: Puddle Deep
barbs.line: Such depth. Ankle-deep, I'd say. Perhaps shin.

barbs.name: Leaking Roof
barbs.line: Your secrets drip, my lord. We can all hear them in the night.

barbs.name: Monsoon
barbs.line: I'd hoped you would pass, like weather. Yet here you remain.

barbs.name: Ghost's Whisper
barbs.line: Your grandfather sat in that seat. He said it fit him better.

barbs.name: Pale Stare
barbs.line: (the white face turns, slowly, and does not blink, because it cannot)

barbs.name: Lingering
barbs.line: Some guests stay long after the party. Most of them are dead. You're the exception.

barbs.name: Restless Water
barbs.line: I can't rest while your verse goes unanswered. No one can. It's that bad.

barbs.name: The Drowned Act
barbs.line: In the last act, the ghost gets the best lines. Here are mine.

barbs.name: Unfired
barbs.line: So soft. You'll set, in time. Most do.

barbs.name: Wet Hands
barbs.line: (she smooths her sleeve slowly, as if shaping something that isn't her sleeve)

barbs.name: Potter's Wheel
barbs.line: You keep turning and turning, and nothing takes shape.

barbs.name: Cracked Glaze
barbs.line: Beautiful outside. One knock, and we'll know what's inside.

barbs.name: Return to Earth
barbs.line: We all go back to the earth eventually. You seem keen to start early.

barbs.name: Clear Green
barbs.line: How pure your intentions are. I can see right through them.

barbs.name: Untainted
barbs.line: (the jade cools against her skin; nothing they say can stick)

barbs.name: Remember Your Name
barbs.line: I remember my name. Do you remember what yours used to mean?

barbs.name: Clean Finger
barbs.line: (she points, once, with one clean finger, at the stain on their sleeve)

barbs.name: Weighed in Jade
barbs.line: Jade weighs a soul. Yours tipped the scale the wrong way, I'm afraid.

barbs.name: Rice-Field Wink
barbs.line: A fine harvest of compliments you brought. All chaff, but a fine harvest.

barbs.name: Nine Tails
barbs.line: (a fox's yip of laughter, from somewhere just behind her)

barbs.name: Kitsune's Bargain
barbs.line: I'll trade you a better poem for your worse one. No? Pity.

barbs.name: Borrowed Shape
barbs.line: I've worn many faces. None as forgettable as yours.

barbs.name: Inari's Rice
barbs.line: The fox steals only from the proud. Look how fat I've grown tonight.

barbs.name: Stone Face
barbs.line: (an expression of perfect, carved disinterest)

barbs.name: Weathered
barbs.line: (she simply waits, the way a stone waits for the rain to finish)

barbs.name: Millstone
barbs.line: You grind on, my lord. Grind, grind, grind. And the flour is always grey.

barbs.name: Garden Rock
barbs.line: Raked gravel goes round a stone. Everyone goes round you, too.

barbs.name: Kaiu Wall
barbs.line: Shout at a wall all you like. The Wall has heard worse. From the Shadowlands.

barbs.name: Open Mouth
barbs.line: Ah. You may enter. The servants' door is to the left.

barbs.name: Closed Mouth
barbs.line: (the guardian's stone mouth shuts with a satisfied click)

barbs.name: Guardian's Ledger
barbs.line: Your name isn't on the list. It isn't on any list, is it?

barbs.name: Paw on the Ball
barbs.line: I keep the world under one paw. You I keep under a claw.

barbs.name: Temple Gate
barbs.line: Every shrine has two guardians: one to welcome, one to judge. I'm not the one who welcomes.

barbs.name: Silk Whisper
barbs.line: Your secret is safe with me. With me, and the eleven people I've told.

barbs.name: Half a Smile
barbs.line: (she smiles with exactly half her face; the other half is listening)

barbs.name: Rehearsal
barbs.line: I rehearsed this conversation last night. You were wittier in rehearsal.

barbs.name: Untied Cord
barbs.line: Your obi has come loose. No, don't look. It's far too late to look.

barbs.name: The Many Faces
barbs.line: I could be anyone. Tonight I'm the one who remembers everything you said.

barbs.name: Soft as Breath
barbs.line: How brave, to wear cotton to court. It must be so... breathable.

barbs.name: Smooth Fold
barbs.line: (her sleeve falls into a perfect fold, as if it had rehearsed)

barbs.name: Weaver's Count
barbs.line: My robe has nine hundred threads to the inch. Your argument has three.

barbs.name: Silk over Steel
barbs.line: Silk wraps a blade, my lord. Wouldn't you like to know whose?

barbs.name: Imperial Bolt
barbs.line: This silk was a gift from the Empress. Yours was a gift too, I'm sure. From someone.

barbs.name: Innocent Question
barbs.line: Forgive me, I'm new to court. Is it the custom to say that out loud?

barbs.name: Downcast Eyes
barbs.line: (the young girl's face tilts down, and the room forgives her everything)

barbs.name: Blossom Fall
barbs.line: Blossoms are lovely because they don't stay. You've stayed quite a while.

barbs.name: Maiden's Fan
barbs.line: (a giggle behind her fan, and the giggle is entirely about them)

barbs.name: Moon on the Water
barbs.line: You reach for me like the moon in a pond. Mind your sleeves. It's deep.

rivals.name: Shosuro Tsuyu
rivals.who: a page of the house, twelve and very serious
rivals.hello: Shosuro-sama! You wear a mask. That means you play. That means you play me.
rivals.win: (bowing very low) I'll practise. I'll practise until my face hurts.
rivals.lose: You need to practise, Shosuro-sama. I'll wait.
rivals.after: Your barbs are better than mine. For now.

rivals.name: Bayushi Gentaro
rivals.who: a gate guard who has been insulted by experts
rivals.hello: Halt. Nobody passes the barracks without a word. A sharp one.
rivals.lose: Back to the gate with you. Come back with a sharper tongue.
rivals.after: I'll be thinking about that one on watch tonight.

rivals.name: Heishiro the groom
rivals.who: a groom in a borrowed courtier's mask
rivals.hello: My lady! The horses don't talk back. Would you?
rivals.win: (laughing) The horses never said anything that bad about me.
rivals.lose: Even the horses were laughing, my lady.
rivals.after: I'll tell the horses. They'll be pleased for you.

rivals.name: Bayushi Karyu
rivals.who: a duellist who prefers words because they leave no blood on the mats
rivals.hello: Shosuro. A blade takes a second. A word takes a whole winter to heal. Draw.
rivals.win: Hm. Take the oni. He's wasted on a man you've just made blush.
rivals.lose: Words leave no marks. You'll feel this one anyway.
rivals.after: The oni likes you better. He always did prefer women.

rivals.name: Yogo Sumie
rivals.who: a poetess who writes verses about her guests, afterwards
rivals.hello: A Shosuro in the garden. How fortunate. I've been short of a subject.
rivals.win: (fanning herself) Take the girl's face. She never did suit me.
rivals.lose: I shall write about you. Not kindly.
rivals.after: I've started the poem. It's about you. It's very flattering. Mostly.

rivals.name: Ide Kaneko
rivals.who: a Unicorn guest who learned the game from losing at it
rivals.hello: They told me the Scorpion play this for fun. I'm here to see if it's fun yet.
rivals.win: It is fun! For one of us. Here, the fox is yours.
rivals.after: I'm writing home about you. They won't believe a word.

rivals.name: Soshi Nobuo
rivals.who: an archivist who has catalogued every insult since the Second Day of Thunder
rivals.hello: Shosuro. Your file is thin. Let us add to it.
rivals.win: Filed under: defeats, regrettable. The ghost is yours.
rivals.lose: Filed under: Shosuro, adequate. For now.
rivals.after: I've updated your file. It's thicker now. Congratulations.

rivals.name: Bayushi Masaru
rivals.who: the officer who keeps the keep's door and its gossip
rivals.hello: Nobody climbs the keep who can't hold their face at the door. Hold yours.
rivals.win: Take my fan. You'll need something to hide behind up there.
rivals.lose: The keep is closed to you. Not literally. Socially.
rivals.after: They're talking about you on the second floor. Good things. Mostly.

rivals.name: Shosuro Asami
rivals.who: an actress who plays the jealous wife in every shrine play
rivals.hello: Every play needs a jealous woman, Mitsue. Tonight it's me. Tomorrow, you.
rivals.win: Take her. She's better at being angry than I am.
rivals.lose: You'll make a lovely jealous wife one day. Practise.
rivals.after: I'm playing a forgiving woman next week. It's my hardest role.

rivals.name: Ochika
rivals.who: a kitchen girl who has heard everything said over every tray
rivals.hello: Begging your pardon, lady. I've carried trays for every lord in this castle. I know what they say.
rivals.win: (curtsying, grinning) I'll save you the good dumplings.
rivals.lose: Pardon, lady. Even the cook heard that.
rivals.after: The cook says you'll do. That's the highest praise there is.

rivals.name: Bayushi Shiramu
rivals.who: an old master who has played since before the Champion was born
rivals.hello: Ah. The young Shosuro. Sit. Lose slowly; I'm old and I enjoy it.
rivals.win: (a dry laugh) Take the tengu. He's been bored with me for years.
rivals.lose: You'll improve. I won't. That's the beauty of it.
rivals.after: Come back when I'm dead. I'll still win.

rivals.name: Yogo Tetsue
rivals.who: a watch-officer who guards the terrace and its view of everyone
rivals.hello: From up here I see everyone who comes in. I saw you. I have notes.
rivals.win: Take the lion-dog. He's tired of watching.
rivals.after: I've moved you to the other list. The short one.

rivals.name: Shosuro Kaname
rivals.who: the stage-master of the house theatre
rivals.hello: The house theatre needs a lead. Audition. Here. Now.
rivals.win: The part is yours. And the cord: every lead ties her mask with it.
rivals.lose: Understudy. Come back when you've learned your lines.
rivals.after: Opening night is whenever you say.

rivals.name: Soshi Rieko
rivals.who: secretary of the council, who writes down what the council didn't say
rivals.hello: The council sits in silence. I write the silence down. Let us see what you leave unsaid.
rivals.win: Take the seal. When you say nothing now, it will be official.
rivals.lose: Minuted: the Shosuro had nothing to say.
rivals.after: I wrote down your silence. It was very eloquent.

rivals.name: Yogo Saburo
rivals.hello: Every insult is a small curse, Shosuro. I keep the ledger. Let's see what you owe.
rivals.win: Your account is settled. Take the charm; it balances the books.
rivals.lose: Entered in the ledger. Interest accrues.
rivals.after: Your page is blank again. Enjoy it.

rivals.name: Bayushi Kyoko
rivals.who: Mistress of Masks of Kyuden Bayushi, who has never lost in this castle
rivals.hello: So you're the one climbing my stairs. Every face in this castle is mine, Shosuro. Let's see yours.
rivals.win: (she takes off her own mask, and smiles with her real face) ...Wear the red one. You've earned it.
rivals.lose: (she doesn't even lower her fan) Again, when you're ready. I'll still be here.
rivals.after: Every face in this castle is mine. Except yours, it seems.
